bespoke.heading: Your vision, our two centuries of karigari
bespoke.intro: From a rough sketch to a 3D CAD render to a hand-finished heirloom — our master artisans in Agra and Surat craft one-of-one pieces for weddings, milestones and legacies. Begin your bespoke journey in three simple steps.

heritage.heading: One unbroken promise.
heritage.intro: For over two centuries, the Bansal family has shaped gold, cut diamonds and set uncut polki in the shadow of the Taj Mahal. Today, the ninth generation carries the same torch — from our foundry in Agra to our atelier in Surat.

milestones.title: Founded in the Historic Heart of Agra
milestones.detail: Established near the historic jewel bazaars of Agra, crafting bespoke gold ornaments for noble families and patrons of fine Mughal filigree.

milestones.title: Mastering the Art of Polki Jadau
milestones.detail: Pioneered proprietary 24K gold foil setting and meenakari enameling, creating heirlooms passed down through generations of Indian weddings.

milestones.title: The Diamond Cutting Atelier
milestones.detail: Established state-of-the-art diamond processing in Surat — direct sourcing, laser grading and zero-mark-up fine diamond jewellery.

milestones.title: 200km Wholesale Network & Digital Luxury
milestones.detail: Led by the ninth generation, modernizing with CAD technology while supplying hallmarked jewellery to retailers across a 200km radius of Agra — and now, to the world.

wholesale.heading: The trusted wholesale house within 200km of Agra
wholesale.intro: We supply certified gold, diamond and polki jewellery to leading retail showrooms across the region — straight from our own manufacturing facilities.
benefits: Custom batch manufacturing at Agra & Surat
